items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Anchor is the invoice date 21.11.2026 (a company invoice has no statutory deemed-delivery rule, so the stated anchor 'Rechnungsdatum' is used directly). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts 22.11.2026. 14 days later is 05.12.2026 (a Saturday). Under §193 BGB, since the obligation is a payment (Leistung), a deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next business day: Monday 07.12.2026. Allowing the standard 1 business day for a SEPA transfer to arrive (§675s BGB), the transfer should be initiated by 04.12.2026, but the payment is legally due by 07.12.2026.
